what: Hero: the large photo panel and the color panel beside it (menu panel) start flush against each other, with the side panel pushed 106px out. .6s after opening, both slide 106px together toward the photo panel over 1.5s ease, so the side panel settles into place and the photo panel shifts aside to interlock. The side panel’s menu and buttons wait another 1.5s and then appear over .9s.

options.delay: Seconds from opening until movement starts, default .6 — 0 means right on attach
options.look: If “left,” the side panel is on the left (the photo panel moves aside to the right and the side panel enters from outside the left)
options.--fx-shift: Slide distance (via style), default 106px — to turn it off on narrow screens, set 0 in the consumer css
options.--fx-after-dur: Duration for the menu and buttons to appear (via style), default .9s
options.--fx-after-delay: Wait time for menu and buttons (via style), default 1.5s
options.[data-fx-part=after]: (optional) menu and buttons that appear after engaging (several children)

from.where: index.html .kv: the original .p-top-kv.is-ready is removed 600ms after DOMContentLoaded. __slider goes translate3d(0)→(-106px) and __sidebar (106px)→(0) with a 1.5s ease transform, and __menu · __buttons fade in over .9s ease after 1.5s (--kv-animation-duration1 · 2 · delay2). Below 1080px nothing moves.
